name: LLM Pulse MCP Server
description: AI visibility analytics for brand mentions, citations, sentiment, share of voice, recommendations, tracked prompts, and AI traffic.

installation.command: git clone https://github.com/LLM-Pulse/llmpulse-mcp && cd llmpulse-mcp && npm ci && npm run smoke

examples: Connect to the hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint at https://api.llmpulse.ai/api/v1/mcp with Bearer authentication.
Use the local wrapper to expose LLM Pulse MCP status and connection metadata to stdio clients.

requirements.other: LLM Pulse API key for authenticated analytics tools

features: Citations, sentiment, and share of voice
Recommendations, tracked prompts, and AI traffic
